structured_output.summary: Iterator.prototype.chunks follows the spec steps in order. It checks `this`, then chunkSize (TypeError, then RangeError), closing the iterator through IteratorClose with the error each time. It then calls GetIteratorDirect and builds the closure through the shared iterator-helper support. The closure uses IteratorStepValue, accumulates a buffer, and yields an array when the buffer reaches chunkSize. At the end it yields the partial buffer, if there is one, and then returns undefined. A return at the final flush yield is discarded, as in step b.ii.1.a. A return at a full-chunk yield closes the underlying iterator (IfAbruptCloseIterator). The buffer is traced for GC. I saw no hardcoding, swallowed errors or unrelated changes. The gate report shows 76 of 76 target tests passing, with no regressions.
